title: Array index possibly out of range lint rule (index-possibly-out-of-range)
summary: Warns on the write of an array index that no dominating guard bounds on both sides before the access; the InRange guard autofix is manual-only
intro: Read this to see when index-possibly-out-of-range warns, how it treats another collection's bound and index parameters, and how its manual-only autofix inserts an InRange check.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint lint <file.pas> [--rule index-possibly-out-of-range] [--fix --fix-rule index-possibly-out-of-range [--apply]] (default ON, category bug-patterns, warning; hint on an unguarded parameter or a lookup-derived index; param exception_class; the autofix is manual only: a batch --fix withholds it, --fix-rule applies it; rules --json carries fix_manual_only: true)
